item.title: [Recap] Nikola Jokić (DEN): Nikola Jokić accounted for 13 points (5-of-19 FGs, 2-of-4 FTs), seven rebounds, five assists, one steal, one block and one three-pointer in Thursday’s loss to the Thunder.
item.description:
Nikola Jokić accounted for 13 points (5-of-19 FGs, 2-of-4 FTs), seven rebounds, five assists, one steal, one block and one three-pointer in Thursday’s loss to the Thunder.

Neither MVP winner in Thursday’s game played well in the first half. The difference was that while Oklahoma City’s Shai Gilgeous-Alexander turned things around in the second half, Jokić could not. The Thunder big men deserve credit for their defense, but “The Joker” couldn’t find a rhythm. He and the Nuggets will look to bounce back when they host the Pelicans on Saturday.

Raphielle Johnson
